projectDescription: A 0.6B parallel decision model built on Qwen3-0.6B that produces complete probability distributions over structured choices, booleans, and scored levels in a single forward pass — no output-token decoding required.
keyFeatures: Zero output-token decoding — decisions read directly from a single forward pass
Parallel batching of multiple independent states and questions in one inference call
Dynamic candidate sets of 2–255 options per Choice question
Three question primitives: Choice (multi-candidate), Boolean (true/false), and Score (ordered levels)
Complete probability distributions for ranking, greedy selection, or sampling
End-to-end training pipeline from programmatic dataset generation to checkpoint evaluation
Persistent HTTP decision service with POST /api/evaluate endpoint
RLCD-inspired calibrated probability learning with CE, Brier, and paired proper-reward objectives
Interactive browser-based game replay for maze and Snake trajectories
Qwen3-0.6B backbone with task-specific decision heads (scalar shared head + set attention for Choice)
publicApiSurface: scripts/evaluate_pipeline_decisions.py — metrics evaluation by split and question type
Training record fields: state, questions, gold_probs, gold_probs_kind, split
